cleaned_entries.title: Spring Boot MySQL .env.example Template
cleaned_entries.content:
Spring Boot MySQL .env.example Template

Safe .env.example for Spring Boot with MySQL. Empty placeholders for MYSQL_DATABASE, MYSQL_USER, MYSQL_PASSWORD, MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD. All values blank to prevent credential leakage.

Decision rules:
- MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD is required by MySQL 8.0 container during initialization even when a regular user is also defined
- Inject real values via CI/CD pipeline secrets (GitHub Actions secrets, GitLab CI variables, etc.) or a vault

Anti-patterns:
- Never set default passwords in .env.example
- Never commit a populated .env file — use .gitignore to exclude .env
